# Zeta Zhang / coolzeta

> Zeta Zhang, also known as Zeta or coolzeta, is an independent maker based in Hong Kong. This personal site contains Zeta's projects and first-person notes on AI agents, creative tools, interactive learning, onchain systems, and electronic music.

Canonical website: https://zeta.lol
English homepage: https://zeta.lol/en
Chinese homepage: https://zeta.lol/zh
Author: Zeta Zhang
Aliases: Zeta, coolzeta
Location: Hong Kong

## Primary sections

- [English notes](https://zeta.lol/en/apps/blog): Essays and technical notes written by Zeta Zhang.
- [中文笔记](https://zeta.lol/zh/apps/blog): Zeta Zhang 的中文文章与个人思考。
- [Playground](https://zeta.lol/en/apps/playground): Independent tools and interactive experiments made by Zeta Zhang.

## Current projects

- [PrompterOne](https://prompterone.app): A teleprompter that follows a speaker's voice and supports recording and remote control.
- [Mechanism Lab](https://chainlab.zeta.lol): Interactive lessons for understanding onchain mechanisms by manipulating them.
- [Soundcraft](https://soundcraft-electronic-music-lab.zetazhang2001.chatgpt.site): An electronic-music learning lab built around making and hearing sound.
